subject: AWS Marketplace listing onboarding: pricing examples, AMI ops, and preflight checklist
messages:

Cc: Helen Cho <h.cho@acme-retail.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Listing onboarding: sample pricing & AMI questions

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking this on. We're ready to start the AWS Marketplace onboarding but have a few practical asks before we finalize the tile:  

- Could you share 2–3 example pricing rows (metered vs subscription) you think fit our usage pattern (~100k tokens/day inference + occasional batch embeddings)?
- For AMI: we plan to bring a hardened container. Do you have the step-by-step AMI upload checklist and suggested instance sizing? Any gotchas for private AMIs or GovCloud?
- Procurement wants a short snippet we can paste into the SOW/PO to explain billing flow (AWS pays via Marketplace, Redwood invoices per token) and sample billing cadence language.

Helen from Procurement is CC'd — she may share the PO template. Can we aim to have the listing copy + procurement snippet by EOD Friday so we can redline?

Thanks,
Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
Head of Platform, Acme Retail

Subject: Re: Listing onboarding: sample pricing & AMI questions

Hi Sanjay — great to hear you’re moving forward. Attaching a short checklist and two example pricing tables (see pricing_examples_v1.xlsx) and the AMI upload steps (AMI-upload-steps.txt). High level answers below; see attachments for exact wording you can paste into the SOW.

Quick answers:
- Pricing examples: We included a subscription tier (monthly committed capacity) and a metered per-token fallback. For your volume, a committed tier with burst credits usually reduces unit cost ~25% vs pure on-demand. See tab "Recommended" in the spreadsheet.
- AMI: follow the attached AMI-upload-steps.txt — includes recommended kernel settings, EBS sizing, and recommended instance types for inference (g5, p4d for heavy batching; g5.x for smaller latency-first endpoints). If you require GovCloud, flag that and we'll coordinate with our listings team.
- Procurement snippet: attached in the spreadsheet and pasted below for convenience. Feel free to copy/paste into your PO or SOW.

Procurement snippet (short):
"Redwood Inference will deliver access to the specified model endpoints via AWS Marketplace. Charges for usage (per-token and/or subscription) will be invoiced by Redwood and billed through AWS Marketplace according to the selected pricing plan. All billing and payment terms are subject to the Marketplace contract between purchaser and AWS."

Next steps:
1) Kimberly will review hero claims and evidence language.
2) Rachel will provide the procurement-friendly snippet with billing footnotes and trial CTA.
3) If that looks good we can set a 30-minute call with your procurement to walk the PO language — how does 11:00 AM PT Monday look?

Thanks — attaching files now.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Field GTM, Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_examples_v1.xlsx (Excel), AMI-upload-steps.txt (text)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Listing onboarding: sample pricing & AMI questions

Looping in a few quick copy/claims notes since this will appear on the public product tile:  

- Hero line: keep it benefit-first and avoid absolute performance claims. Suggest: "Low-latency, cost-efficient LLM inference for production apps."
- Footnote for pricing: include a short asterisk: "*Committed tiers provide discounted unit pricing; actual charges billed through AWS Marketplace."
- Evidence / trust claims: we should not say "99.99% uptime" unless ops has signed off — instead use "SLA-backed availability options" and link to the Dedicated offering page (HBSP-7821).

Also — AMI tagging: make sure the AMI manifest includes the following tags: redwood:compatible=true, release:stable, region:us-west-2. This avoids manual approvals during the AMI verification step.

I'll add these recommended snippets into the shared Drive doc (linked) and flag for legal review if you want.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Product Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks — adding the procurement snippet optimized for PO insertion. Feel free to paste the block below into your SOW/PO template:  

"Billing and Payment: Charges for usage of Redwood Inference services will be remitted through AWS Marketplace under the purchaser's Marketplace account. Redwood Inference will provide monthly usage reports. Billing cadence: monthly in arrears. For committed tiers, any pre-paid credits will be applied against usage. Contact: billing@redwood.com."

Trial CTA (tile): "Start a 14-day trial via AWS Marketplace; no credit card required. Trial converts to paid subscription via the Marketplace console."

Region footnote for procurement: "For GovCloud or specific-regional billing, please contact marketplace-onboarding@redwood.com to confirm regional entitlements and AMI visibility."

DocuSign/links: I dropped a staging DocuSign template for Acme in our drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1example-docs-for-listing (useful for legal to pre-populate).

Rachel Kim
